limits: Edges are syntactic references. A trigger dispatching through custom metadata (TDTM and similar) reaches its handler with no reference to follow, so those edges are absent unless a coverage run revealed them.
This is reachability, not test selection. It must not be used to decide which tests to skip.

SObject nodes exist only for objects this code touches or a trigger runs on — this is not the org's schema. The edges read object names Apex spells out, so dynamic SOQL, DML on a generic SObject, and access from Flows or LWC are absent until a coverage run records them.

Flow edges are read from flow metadata: the object a flow is triggered on, the Apex actions and subflows it names, and the objects its record elements touch. An action called through a dynamically built name, and anything a flow reaches through a screen or a component, are not read.
